newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan buys 270,000 T US soft white wheat - agent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys 270,000 T US soft white wheat - agent.

text.p: Pakistan bought on Monday 270,000 tonnes U.S. soft white wheat for November 12-30 delivery, its U.S. export agent said.
Pakistan bought four lots of 20,000 tonnes each at $143.31 a tonne, $143.67, $144.04 and $144.42, FOB, from Columbia Grain, the agent, Universal Shipping Co said.
The deal also included one lot of 25,000 tonnes at $143.88 a tonne from Granplex and three lots of 20,000 tonnes each at $144.41, $144.78 and $144.97 a tonne from United Grain Corp.
Three lots of 25,000 tonnes each were bought at $145.18, $145.54 and $145.91 a tonne from Louis Dreyfus.
One lot at 10,000 tonnes at $145.58 a tonne and another lot for 5,000 tonnes at $145.95 was purchased from Harvest States.
One lot of 15,000 tonnes was bought at $145.67 a tonne from Continental Grain. Shipping was via Columbia River District, including Portland or CRDIP, the agent said.
